play_name: Put your energy where there's real back-and-forth
behavioral_target: Keeping effort going toward matches who do not write back, instead of letting real responses guide where your time goes.
trigger: You match with people on an app, but many never reply or the chat dies fast.
old_play: You keep matching and keep trying with people who go quiet.
function_of_old_play: It keeps you active in the dating pool and keeps you trying instead of stopping.
new_play: When you match, watch to see if they actually write back and keep it going. Put your time into the ones who do. If a match stays quiet, let that tell you where not to spend more effort.
what_to_expect: You may let go of quiet matches you hoped would come around. That can feel like a small loss each time. But you will spend less time on chats that go nowhere.
why_supports_task: It helps you tell who really shows up from who does not. That is the kind of noticing Discernment is built on.
maintaining_behaviors_consolidated: Continuing to match with and put effort into people who never respond, rather than letting mutual back-and-forth guide where energy goes.
context_limitations: Matching with a lot of people is normal on apps. This is not about matching less. It is about where you put your energy after you match.
review_reason: Built from a single Context-Dependent behavior; 'who never respond' is partly an outcome the person does not control, so the maintaining read is conditional.
